decision.title: Maps and records (packet )
decision.summary: Maps are entry blocks with a hash index above 8 entries, persistent AVL entry and key trees for put and remove, or records whose field keys are made on first need.

body.p: . src/xdm_map.c; three cell classes behind SXML_ITEM_REPRESENTATION_MAP_CELL, told apart by cell class.

item.p: Entry block (sxml_map_make): entries in one cell. Maps of more than 8 entries get a hash index (key hash, entry index; open addressing, load at most 1/2). Duplicate detection needs it, so it is built while making and kept, not built on first lookup (a refinement of ); maps of 8 entries or fewer are searched linearly.

Persistent map (sxml_map_put, sxml_map_remove): an entry tree (AVL, ordered by entry stamp, entry counts per subtree) and a key tree (AVL, ordered by key hash, then stamp), both of cells shared by path copying. Put and remove are O(log n), sxml_map_get_entry and sxml_map_find O(log n). A new key gets the next stamp, so it goes last; a removed and re-added key goes last too. Put on an existing key keeps the old key and its position and replaces the value (which key is kept is implementation-dependent, QT4 map-put-011). Put or remove on an entry block or record converts it in O(n log n) once; results of 8 entries or fewer stay entry blocks (copied).

Record: the cell holds the record type, the field values and s, made on first need (sxml_map_get_entry, sxml_map_find) in a side table of the cell; lookup by name goes through sxml_type_registry_find_record_field, shared by every record of the type. Only string-family keys (xs:string, xs:anyURI, xs:untypedAtomic) can match a field. Put and remove give a plain map (persistent or block). Because field keys are made lazily, sxml_map_get_entry on a record can return the heap's failures on its first call (P3).
